title: Slip
description: A Smalltalk environment in the file. Evaluate in a Workspace, browse and change classes, inspect objects, debug a run, keep objects, build apps on morphs in the World (Cards is one), and let an agent change and run the code; the classes and methods you make are kept as records.

settings.title: Run an agent's evaluations
settings.help: When on, Slip runs the Smalltalk an agent asks for in st.evaluation records as it comes, on this computer. When off, each waits in a queue until you press Run.
